utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I heard the repair drive is picking up nicely — folks are dropping off tools and parts already. I’ll check back later and see if they need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good. I like having a clear list, so I’ll check in later and see what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll swing by later and see what’s been claimed. Hopefully we can keep it moving smoothly.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m happy to help, but can you give me the quick version of what needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — the drive has a few cracks and a loose edge by the gate. We mainly need patching and a quick leveling.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — cracks, a loose edge by the gate, and some patching plus leveling. I can probably help if you keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So the repair drive is definitely happening, right? Just want to make sure before I tell anyone.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yeah, it’s happening, but we should keep an eye on the timing and supplies so nothing gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, good to know. Can you confirm the date and what supplies we still need?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m happy to help out, I just need to write down the details before I forget them.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great—I'll jot them down too, just in case. We mainly need tools, spare wire, and a couple of lanterns.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it—tools, spare wire, and a couple lanterns. I’ll see what I can bring over and write it down right now before it slips my mind.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before I do anything, can you confirm what needs repairing and where we’re meeting for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, I think it’s the broken fence by the community lot, and we’re meeting at the corner near the mailbox. Sorry, I’ve been a bit scattered today.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: No worries — just to confirm, we’re fixing the broken fence by the community lot and meeting at the corner near the mailbox, right?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a bit late, but I heard there’s a repair drive going on. What do you need help with?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Dane, thanks for checking in — we’re mostly looking for tools, spare parts, and hands to help fix up a few bikes and small appliances. If you’ve got a minute, I can point you to whatever’s needed most.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure, I can spare a minute. Point me to whatever’s needed most, and I’ll jump in.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, Gus — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Sam — could you help me sort the donated tools and maybe keep an eye on the table while I set things up?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, Gus — I can sort the donated tools and watch the table while you set up.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I haven’t seen the repair drive location posted yet, but I can help track it down.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Opal. If you find it, please let me know—I need to plan around the school pickup schedule.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely, I’ll keep an eye out and let you know as soon as I find the location.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, right—the repair drive. I heard folks are still figuring out what’s needed, but I can pass along anything I hear.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Tess! If you hear anything, let me know—I’m happy to pass the word along and help get folks involved.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You bet—I’ll keep my ears open and let you know as soon as I hear more. Appreciate you helping spread the word, Quinn!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, what kind of repairs are we prioritizing for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’d start with the most urgent stuff first, like leaky roofs, broken heaters, and anything that affects safety. We can sort the rest after that.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: That makes sense. Do you want me to make a priority list and see who needs the most urgent help first?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’m still planning to swing by the repair drive and let everyone know what’s going on.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh good, thanks for letting folks know — I’ve been hearing bits and pieces, so that’ll help.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No problem — I’ll keep people posted if anything changes and make sure the details get around.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Uli, I’m putting the repair drive details in order now—have you got a list of what still needs fixing? We can match it up with the volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ve got a few things written down, but I’m still sorting through it. I can bring you the list later today.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’d be perfect, Uli—thanks. Bring it by later, and I’ll match everything up with the volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard folks are still gathering tools and a few donations, so it’s coming along. If you’re headed over, you might want to bring gloves—there’s always a lot to sort through.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Tess. I’ll bring gloves and stop by when everything’s set, so I can help sort things out.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d be great, Eli—people will be glad to have an extra pair of hands. I’ll let you know if they need anything else before you come by.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey, sorry I’m late — is the repair drive still going on? I can help if you still need hands.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, it’s still going on — we could definitely use the help. Come by when you can and I’ll fill you in.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, I’m on my way — I’ll swing by in a few and pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard the repair drive is coming up. Do you know what they still need?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’m not sure about the full list, but I can ask around and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, I’d appreciate that. I’m happy to help once we know what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I’m in—just point me to what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, thanks, Bo. The repair drive is at the community center parking lot—just head there and look for the blue tent.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll head to the community center parking lot and look for the blue tent.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds like a great chance for the whole neighborhood to pitch in. Want me to help spread the word about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That would be great, thanks—could you share the basics first? I want to make sure the details are right before we spread it around.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — it’s a neighborhood repair drive to help fix up a few shared spaces, and I can send you the key details so we get everything right before sharing it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive — I think I heard about that. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Mostly a few hands and any tools folks can spare—if you’re free, come by and I’ll put you to work.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure, I can swing by and help out. I’ll see if I can bring a tool or two as well.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a nice little turnout. I’ll swing by after my errands and see if they still need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That’d be great, Ira—there’s always something to pitch in on. Swing by when you can, and I’ll point you to whatever still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good, Gus—I’ll stop by once I finish up and see what needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Leo — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. Just let me know what you need me to do.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Sam. Could you help sort donations and carry the boxes this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, Leo — I can sort donations and help carry the boxes this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I’ll need the exact time and where we’re dropping things off so I can plan it properly.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Could you do Saturday at 10, and we’d be dropping everything off at the community center on Oak Street?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Saturday at 10 works for me, and the community center on Oak Street is fine. Just let me know if there are any parking or loading details I should plan for.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I’ve already been telling folks about the repair drive—if you can make it, I’d love for you to come by and lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can come by and help out. Just tell me what you need me to bring.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s great—thanks, Cleo! If you could bring a pair of work gloves and maybe a screwdriver, that’d be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule for the repair drive—what time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thank you, Faye—how about Saturday morning around 10? That should give folks time after the school run.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday morning at 10 works for me—I can help spread the word around the school schedule, too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’m glad we’re doing this repair drive together—there’s a lot we can get done if we stay organized. What do you want to tackle first, Nell?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces, so I’d follow your lead—what needs the most help first?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Let’s start with the homes that have urgent safety issues—leaks, broken steps, or no heat. Then we can sort the rest by what we can fix quickest.
